text: A --cpu 2 hmmsearch keeps about 2.7 cpus busy (a master and two workers). On michi 0.1.0's private 2-core leases a batch ran 1.5-1.6x slower than the same batch sharing one pool: a job's threads leave its private cpus idle when one stalls, and on 48 cpus with 24 jobs only 34 did work. That is why util::search::hmmer gives its batch one pool and its parts no cores. Measured in September 2026; the probe's output was deleted.
